title: FemTheme Solo #014 · 여 블랙 글래머·소피아로렌풍·경찰관 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit red-rock canyon floor with a smooth sandy path, low boulders of knee height and a waist-high wooden trail rail, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Italian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, a smouldering, confident expression, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, a bronze chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold miniature anvil, a lead ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold necklaces. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black police cap with a silver badge and steel handcuffs hanging from one hip string, a micro strapless black leather bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, and a minimal black leather micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme gold platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: a bright rim of sunlight outlining every figure, each material catching the backlight in glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
